description: The handler returns a response with status 600, outside 200..599: the SDK answers 500 {"error":"handler error"} instead (with an error event), never a status line it cannot stand behind. MCPWARP.md §4.5: a handler or target status < 200 or >= 600 becomes 500.
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
mcp-session-id: abc
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 25

{"error":"handler error"}
notes: Status 599 is in range and passes through. Where the runtime's response type cannot hold 600 at all (a fetch Response throws a RangeError), the runner's handler returns whatever response-like value the SDK accepts with status 600; if the SDK accepts none, the case is the handler-throws 500 of handler_throw_500 and is skipped with a note.
